name: Hotel Surabhi Grand Family Restaurant
area: Opposite Andhra Bank, Netaji Chowk, Adilabad town
why_it_matters: A central, well-rated multi-cuisine family restaurant at Netaji Chowk — Adilabad town's main square. In a district town with limited dining, Surabhi Grand is one of the most consistently named addresses for biryani, tiffins and Chinese, listed across Zomato, Swiggy and Justdial.
insider_tip: The Netaji Chowk location makes it the easy town-centre meal. Biryani is the order; the South Indian tiffins cover breakfast. Adilabad is non-veg country — the meat dishes are the local strength. Walk-in.
signature_address: Opposite Andhra Bank, Netaji Chowk, Adilabad town, Adilabad District, Telangana 504001

name: Rajadhani Multicuisine Family Restaurant
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine veg and non-veg family meals
why_it_matters: One of the highest-volume restaurants in Adilabad — rated 3.9 across more than 800 reviews — on Pittalwada Road in Dasnapur, under a kilometre from the railway station. A reliable multi-cuisine family stop for travellers arriving by train.
insider_tip: Its proximity to the railway station makes it a natural arrival or departure meal. Biryani and tandoori are the picks; the kitchen handles a broad veg-and-non-veg menu. Walk-in.
signature_address: Pittalwada Road, Sapthagiri Colony, Dasnapur, Adilabad, Adilabad District, Telangana 504001

name: Lotus Family Restaurant
area: Opposite New Bus Stand, Bhuktapur, Adilabad
why_it_matters: A long-running biryani and Mughlai address opposite Adilabad's New Bus Stand — listed on Zomato (as Lotus Grand Family Restaurant), Swiggy, Tripadvisor and Justdial. Convenient for bus travellers and a dependable non-veg option in a town where meat dishes dominate.
insider_tip: Opposite the New Bus Stand, so an easy first or last meal in Adilabad. Open roughly 11.30am-11pm; biryani and kebabs are the strengths. Per-head spend lands around ₹200-400. Walk-in.
signature_address: Opposite New Bus Stand, Ravinder Nagar Colony, Bhuktapur, Adilabad, Adilabad District, Telangana 504001

name: Nirmal Dhaba
why_it_matters: A roadside dhaba in Adilabad town known for honest desi cooking — the kind of casual highway-style eatery where you eat hearty dhaba dishes at low prices. A real, Tripadvisor-listed option for travellers who want a simple no-frills meal.
insider_tip: Go for the dhaba chicken and a fresh tandoori roti — this is comfort food, not fine dining. Casual roadside seating; quick and cheap. Confirm timings as small-town dhabas can vary.
signature_address: Opposite Kanchar Road Katta, Adilabad town, Adilabad District, Telangana 504001

name: Kakaku The Guest House Restaurant
signature_dish: Home-style local cuisine near Kuntala Falls
why_it_matters: The closest eatery to Kuntala Waterfall — Telangana's tallest falls — set just 322m from the cascade in Neredigonda mandal. Adilabad district's waterfall belt has almost no dining infrastructure, so this guesthouse restaurant is effectively the only proper meal at the Kuntala/Pochera falls cluster.
insider_tip: Local-cuisine breakfast is served daily 8-10.30am; lunch and dinner are best arranged ahead with the small kitchen since it primarily serves staying guests. Pair a meal here with the Kuntala and Pochera waterfall stops — there is little else to eat nearby.
signature_address: Near Kuntala Waterfall, Neredigonda mandal, Adilabad District, Telangana 504307
